summary_en: This Phase I study tests camonsertib, a drug also called an ATR inhibitor, combined with stereotactic body radiation therapy for head and neck squamous cell cancer that has come back or cannot be removed by surgery. Camonsertib is taken by mouth once a day on the day of and the day after each radiation treatment, and radiation is given in 4 or 5 sessions, twice a week, over about 3 weeks. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose, and it is a Phase I trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase I evalúa camonsertib, un medicamento también llamado inhibidor de ATR, combinado con radioterapia corporal estereotáctica para el carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello que ha regresado o que no puede extirparse con cirugía. El camonsertib se toma por vía oral una vez al día, el día del tratamiento de radiación y el día siguiente, y la radiación se administra en 4 o 5 sesiones, dos veces por semana, durante unas 3 semanas. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis más adecuada, y es un estudio de fase I.

Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or better, and adequate blood counts and organ function.
not_for: More than one prior course of head and neck radiation overlapping the treated region.
Disease surrounding more than 180 degrees of the carotid artery.
Tumor invading the mandible or causing gross skin ulceration.
